interpretation: Separate post-stop amendment; original batch remains MODEL_OUTPUT_FAILURE and its first invalid trial is never replaced.
Reconstructed native bodies use the frozen builder, saved logical requests and actual recorded PNG bytes; they are not independent captures of network payload bytes.
Native input equality is separate from model output and subsequent assessment/action input equality. Fresh native outputs can cause input divergence before the first UI choice.
Each verified local baseline-to-final substitution is attributable to the applied saved multiplier on that selection. Do not infer an unexecuted whole-trajectory ON/OFF counterfactual.
Retry and ABAB counts are descriptive; goal outcome does not rank motion or human naturalness.
